verdict.rationale: GitHub Projects ships its own built-in workflows that automatically set fields when items are added or changed, which is a genuine background automation. The only evidence is a single line, and its documented scope is limited to setting fields on item events. GitHub Actions and the GraphQL API are building blocks for custom automation rather than turnkey autonomous automations, so they earn no credit here. Missing for 10: documented range of workflow triggers and actions, scheduled/recurring automation, agentic or AI-driven background automation within Projects, and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Built-in workflows allow you to automatically set fields when items are added or changed
